answer.reason: Besides the lists, the verses say Reuben built it and that its vines were broken down and its vintage ruined.

clauses.english: was built by the children of Reuben
clauses.quote: and Shibmah: and gave other names unto the cities which they builded

clauses.english: had its vines broken down and its vintage ruined by spoilers
clauses.quote: the spoiler is fallen upon thy summer fruits and upon thy vintage

doubts: NUM 32:3 has "Shebam", likely the same place, but I left it out as a bare list.
NUM 32:38 spells it Shibmah, and the clause that Reuben built it rests on the list running on from NUM 32:37.
JOS 13:19 only lists it among cities, so I did not use it.
